articles.title: Strategy's valuation has fallen below the value of its bitcoin holdings
articles.snippet: For years, investors had valued the firm well above its bitcoin holdings, giving Strategy massive flexibility to raise capital as needed — a situation Michael Saylor and team took full advantage of.

articles.title: Anti-trafficking group says Clarity Act's Section 604 could weaken accountability
articles.snippet: An anti-human trafficking advocate said a Clarity Act provision could weaken accountability despite existing criminal laws.

articles.title: Fidelity rebuts claims Bitcoin becomes less secure after halvings
articles.snippet: The asset manager argues Bitcoin's fixed supply schedule does not undermine network security, even as miners face shrinking block rewards after each halving.

articles.title: US senators urge CFTC probe Polymarket over ‘deceptive marketing’
articles.snippet: Senators John Curtis and Adam Schiff are concerned about the CFTC’s enforcement ability after a “troubling” report on Polymarket’s advertising.

articles.title: Old Ether wallets move 37,806 ETH as whale conviction faces key test at $1.5K
articles.snippet: Old Ether wallets moved 37,806 ETH as long-term whale profitability turned negative for the first time since 2019, signaling mixed sentiment among large holders.
